facts.fact: 铰链点焊、滑轮焊死梁上——焊点已有锈斑：不是一天前做的。
facts.anchor: they looked older than a day, speckles of rust already tinging the exposed material.

facts.fact: 四案全在第一案执行前规划——Laura Walker 是最后一个。
facts.anchor: All four murders planned before the first one was even executed.

facts.fact: 配重机制：门开→缆紧→按入水中固定——开门动作差点密封她的命运。
facts.anchor: the whole rig had snapped tight, dragging her under and pinning her in place

facts.fact: Alex 内疚：昨晚该坚持让 Harper 一家出镇——如果她更强硬。
facts.anchor: She could have got her out of Dunning right then.

facts.fact: 凶手预判：水公司会报警→派人来→看到保时捷→层层上报→引他们来。
facts.anchor: The killer must have known that the water company would be alerted when the pressure dropped.

facts.fact: 三天三受害者——第四个 24 小时内；Grant 仍会拒绝送走妻子。
facts.anchor: they had less than twenty-four hours until the fourth was taken.
